ValidationRule.description: Prevents delegated administrators from creating or editing users. FYS Supervisor can edit FYS staff member's Out of Office.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( OR (ISNEW(),ISCHANGED( Email ),ISCHANGED( Alias ),ISCHANGED( Username ),ISCHANGED( FederationIdentifier) ), $User.ProfileId <> '00ed00000017Iob' ), AND( $User.ProfileId = '00ed0000000jboW' , NOT( OR(ISCHANGED(Out_Of_Office_Message__c), ISCHANGED( omniChannel_loggedIn__c)) ), Alias <> $User.Alias ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only System Administrators can create or edit users. Please contact salesforce.support@asu.edu.
